en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cloistered courtyard with a formal garden of low box hedges and flower beds. An arcade with rounded arches and simple columns surrounds the courtyard on two levels. Above the cloister rises a square church bell tower with three stages of arched openings and a small pyramidal roof topped by a cross. The surrounding walls show aged plaster and shuttered windows, suggesting an old monastery or convent complex in a European town.
